asked.item: Caption missing from TikTok draft; did I type it wrong?
How to get the caption back before publishing

verdict.reason: The sentences say captions are not carried over when publishing a TikTok post as a draft, and say to re-enter the caption in the TikTok app.

steps.text: Captions are not carried over when publishing a TikTok post as a draft.
This is a TikTok API limitation.
After the draft is created, open the TikTok app and re-enter your caption before publishing the draft.
